description: Approve & allocate: the lines that use the persona's fleet (the sourcing BU decides, MC-FR-13/14). v = fxOps.approvals(state) (store.view('approvals') with each line's facts, its unit options preferred first, usable or why not, and what approving sets off), set by loadChain on vbEnter and on every fxRefresh. Every action opens a confirmation first (askChain: fxOps.ask, a dry run of the engine that says what EquipRite does and what Fusion would do); Confirm runs it through actChain (fxPage.act), and a failure stays in the dialog and on the page.

picks.description: The unit chosen on each line's radio list: { lineId: unitId } (else the line's defaultPick).

rel.description: The relationship chip on: all, IC_DOMESTIC, IC_CROSS_BORDER, SAME_LE, CUSTOMER, SAME_BU.

askDef.description: The confirmation open (fxOps.ask().def): its words and fields; kept while the fields are typed in.

form.description: The values typed in the confirmation's fields.

ask.description: fxOps.ask().preview: what EquipRite does, the money, what Fusion would do, who is told; the action and its payload.

askError.description: Why the last Confirm did not go through, in the engine's words (stays in the dialog).

failure.description: The last action that did not go through, kept on the page until dismissed or until an action works.

exportOpen.description: The list whose export menu is open.

fxRefresh.description: From the page module (fxPage.watch): the store changed, so loadChain runs again.
